chapter_seo_title: Ji Ning Enters the World Prison: One Wrong Word Exposes Him
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning ventures into the World Prison. His heartforce clashes with ancient powers. But a single careless sentence to a Celestial Immortal prisoner shatters his disguise in an instant.
og_title: Desolate Era 605: The Prisoner Who Saw Through Ji Ning with One Question
og_description: A single conversation shatters Ji Ning’s disguise. The World Prison holds secrets older than the Three Realms.
twitter_title: A mere Celestial Immortal catches Ji Ning lying in one sentence. The World Prison is no joke.
twitter_description: Ji Ning’s first interrogation in the World Prison fails instantly. These prisoners are not just strong—they are cunning survivors of endless ages.

lore_anchors.definition: A precious liquid refined from primordial chaos, used as a fuel for certain high-level soul-splitting techniques. Ji Ning used a full vial to perfect the second layer of his Tao Wu bodies.
A formless, will-based power distinct from spiritual energy. It is derived from a cultivator's Dao-heart and mental fortitude, making it dangerous to clash with masters of the art.
The binding chains of the World Prison. They appear as physical restraints but are actually bound directly to the prisoner's truesoul.
A vast, sealed dimension used to imprison ancient cultivators. No energy can be absorbed within; prisoners survive only by rationing their own power and stored pills.
The Fiendgod Body Refining parallel to a Pure Yang True Immortal. A being whose divine body has been perfected by resisting the Pure Yang Golden Light Tribulation-Thunder.
The highest realm of Fiendgod Body Refining within the Three Realms. Equivalent in power level to a Daofather.
